Role: Software developer. Project: - School ERP Client: - Cordova Learning Solutions. Project Description: - School ERP software is a robust, time-tested educational ERP system integrated with the advanced modules to enable faculty & educators to digitize the daily work processes of educational institutions. Also referred to as a school management system, the smart school ERP software simplifies the complex administrative & non-administrative tasks including online admission, online fees. management, examination management, assessments, timetable, schedule planning, teaching- learning, etc. Programming skill: - Entity Framework, JSON, C#.Net and MVC, Linq, SQL Server, Angular.

The application managed patients, doctors, appointments, prescriptions, and billing. I was responsible for creating REST APIs, implementing JWT authentication, designing database tables, optimizing Entity Framework queries, and integrating the React frontend with the .NET backend. We followed clean architecture, Dependency Injection and SOLID principles to build a scalable and maintainable application. Programming skill: - C#, .Net core, MVC, LINQ, REST API.

Windows based Billing, Inventory Management and Accounting Software. It can handle multiple customers by allowing to hold current invoice and pick it later. Programming skill: - C#, SQL Server, MVC.
